title: Sandtrap Escape
meta_description: Find the perfect Miramar Beach, FL vacation rental at “Sandtrap Escape”, a luxury 7-bed, 7.5-bath vacation rental. Ideal for 16 guests, this home offers a Private Pool & Spa, Game Room, Rooftop Deck & Elevator. Book your memorable stay now!
description_expanded: Home Highlights - Private Resort Style Pool with Hot Tub (Pool can be heated for an additional $70 per day between Oct 1 - May 1) - Elevator - Game Room - Short Walk to the Beach Access - 6 Adult Bikes Included Located in the enchanting Miramar Beach, Sandtrap Escape redefines coastal living, offering an unmatched fusion of seaside allure and contemporary opulence. This coastal retreat serves as your gateway to picturesque beachfront roads, charming surf boutiques, delectable dining establishments, chic oceanfront estates, and awe-inspiring vistas of the Gulf of Mexico. Miramar Beach, one of South Walton’s most vibrant and diverse coastal communities, beckons you to immerse yourself in a world of excitement and tranquility. This extraordinary luxury property provides an unparalleled living experience. The initial level boasts a generously-sized half bathroom, a master bedroom fit for royalty, and an opulent master bathroom featuring a walk-in shower and a single vanity. This residence places a premium on comfort and style. The open-concept layout is enhanced by exquisite Luxury Vinyl Plank (LPV) flooring, creating an airy and luminous ambiance. Culinary enthusiasts will be enamored with the well-appointed kitchen, complete with top-of-the-line stainless steel appliances, a gas range, and a custom-designed hood. Abundant pantry and storage space ensure effortless organization. The living room showcases a contemporary fireplace and streams of natural light through expansive sliding doors leading to the pool area. Step outside to discover an alfresco kitchen with a dining and lounging area, complete with a state-of-the-art TV, an inviting pool, and a serene hot tub equipped with Aqualink technology. Moreover, the dining area comfortably accommodates ten guests at the table, while four bar stools offer additional seating options. This property is the epitome of luxury living. On the second level, guests will find an exquisite king-sized bedroom, boasting a balcony with captivating pool views – a true oasis of relaxation. Its ensuite bathroom features a standalone tub, a walk-in shower, and two sophisticated vanities, perfect for indulging in style. Another king-sized bedroom, also with a balcony and pool views, ensures every morning begins with a breathtaking vista. Its bathroom boasts a spacious walk-in shower and two vanities for added convenience. For moments of leisure and entertainment, a well-appointed wet bar awaits, complete with a wine cooler and a sink, making it the ideal spot for hosting guests. Even bedrooms without a view maintain the same lofty standards of luxury. Their ensuite bathrooms feature walk-in showers and single vanities, upholding the property’s commitment to opulence. Practicality meets extravagance with a spacious laundry room, equipped with two stacked washer and dryer sets, sinks, ample folding space, and an additional sink for added convenience. The final king-sized bedroom, located at the front of the house, has its private balcony for a more secluded retreat. Its ensuite bathroom features a walk-in shower and a single vanity, rounding out the exceptional offerings of this luxury property. The exceptional top-level retreat defines indulgence and leisure. As you ascend the staircase, you’ll be greeted by an expansive game and living room, complete with a pristine pool table and stunning sliders that open onto the top-level deck. The wet bar is a masterpiece of design, featuring high-top seating, a convenient mini fridge, and a sleek sink for all your entertainment needs. A full bathroom, elegantly appointed, is shared with the adjacent bunk room and common area. This bathroom boasts a connected tub and shower and a single vanity for added convenience. The bunk room itself is a haven of comfort, offering two twin-over-twin bunks, perfect for accommodating guests or family. Meanwhile, a queen bedroom awaits, featuring its luxurious bath with a walk-in shower, exuding modern elegance. This top-level sanctuary embodies the epitome of luxury living, providing both comfort and sophistication. In summary, Sandtrap Escape exemplifies coastal elegance and contemporary luxury at its finest in the heart of Miramar Beach. Nestled amidst the scenic beachfront roads, this coastal haven offers an extraordinary blend of relaxation and adventure. From the private resort-style pool with a hot tub to the game room and the convenience of an elevator, every detail has been meticulously designed to ensure your stay is nothing short of exceptional. Sandtrap Escape isn’t just a place to stay; it’s an immersive experience. Secure your escape today and uncover the enchantment of coastal living at its zenith. Your voyage to relaxation, adventure, and Gulf Coast splendor commences here. Sleeping Arrangements First Floor King Bedroom w/ Private Bathroom, Shower Only Half Bathroom Second Floor Master King Bedroom w/ Private Bathroom, Shower /Tub Separate King Bedroom w/ Private Bathroom, Shower Only King Bedroom w/ Private Bathroom, Shower Only King Bedroom w/ Private Bathroom, Shower Only Third Floor 2 Twin/Twin Bunk Room w/ Shared Bathroom, Shower/Tub combo Queen Bedroom w/ Private Bathroom, Shower Only *This home is pet-friendly, if approved, and with the addition of pet fees*
